jobs.title: Business Development Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
About AQR Capital Management

Founded in 1998, AQR is a global systematic investment management firm. As quantitative investors, research is the foundation of everything we do. We manage a range of alternative and long-only strategies designed to meet the needs of institutional and wealth investors around the world.

AQR’s culture reflects the firm’s academic roots and entrepreneurial spirit. Our collaborative environment fuels innovation and encourages employees to ask thoughtful questions, think creatively and bring new ideas forward. Continuous learning is an important part of the employee experience, helping our people build skills and grow throughout their careers. Employees at every level have opportunities to contribute, regardless of title or tenure.

The firm has 800 employees with headquarters in Greenwich, Connecticut and offices in London, Frankfurt, Dubai, Hong Kong, Sydney and Bengaluru.

The Team

AQR is looking to hire a full-time Associate on our U.S. Wealth Team, within the Business Development group in a Business Development Strategy role. The Business Development group works with AQR’s clients in North America, Europe, Australia and the Middle East to provide solutions to achieve their investment objectives. AQR clients include a cross-section of the world’s largest institutional investors, such as public and corporate pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and foundations and endowments. AQR also serves the private-wealth community and Registered Investment Advisors.

- U.S. Wealth - The U.S. Wealth group was created to engage with taxable U.S. investors and their advisors. The group is responsible for education, awareness and managing new and current client relationships for AQR strategies through dedicated coverage to the Family Office community, Registered Investment Advisor community, as well as elite advisors and teams within the major Broker-Dealer segment.

Role Overview

As a member of the U.S. Wealth Business Development Strategy team, you will work directly with senior leadership on the key priorities driving the growth of AQR’s US Wealth business. The role is a mix of strategy, analytics, and execution, with a focus on helping leadership make better decisions and ensuring the business is focused on the right things.

You will work closely with the leaders of AQR’s US Wealth channels, including RIAs, Broker Dealers, and Family Offices, while also partnering across the organization with teams in corporate functions, operations, technology, and portfolio management.

Key Responsibilities

- Work with U.S. Wealth leadership to define and drive key business priorities and growth initiatives

- Build analytical models, including demand, pipeline, and financial models, to support decision-making

- Evaluate new business opportunities, including potential corporate investments and partnerships

- Analyze business performance and develop KPIs to track progress against goals

- Identify issues, trade-offs, and areas that need leadership attention

- Work across teams to keep initiatives moving and ensure follow-through

- Partner with the sales team to analyze pipeline, client trends, and areas of opportunity

- Support market and competitor analysis to inform strategy

- Prepare materials for leadership meetings and business updates

- Support adhoc projects across other channels including but not limited to Institutional and International Wealth, as needed

What You’ll Bring

- A Bachelor’s degree; Exceptional academic performance demonstrating achievement and commitment to excellence

- 3-5 years of experience in top-tier management consulting (MBB or equivalent; experience in Financial Institutions or Wealth & Asset Management practices is highly desirable)

- Basic knowledge of the Wealth & Asset Management industry

- Strong quantitative skills

- Strong project management skills, with exceptional attention to detail

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; must be able to build and maintain strong relationships with a variety of internal colleagues across teams

- High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

- Experience in Salesforce CRM is a plus

- Experience in managing large data sets

- Ability to function at a high level of autonomy and be a self-starter

- Ability to handle a wide array of issues – needs to multi-task and be willing to roll up sleeves and do whatever is needed

Who You Are

- Committed to intellectual curiosity and integrity, with a high degree of ethics

- Mature and thoughtful, with the ability to operate within a collaborative, team – oriented culture as well as operate independently

- Hard working and eager to learn in a highly intellectual, innovative environment

- Well – organized, detail oriented; able to multi – task and keep track of various deadlines

- Look beyond the surface level to understand the underlying details

The salary range for this role is expected to be $120,000 to $140,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is accurate for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, depending upon factors such as skills, experience, location, or other business and organizational needs. This wage range may also be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

AQR is an Equal Opportunity Employer. EEO/VET/DISABILITY

jobs.title: Managed Futures & Commodities Research Analyst
jobs.description:
About AQR Capital Management

AQR is a global investment firm built at the intersection of financial theory and practical application. We strive to deliver concrete, long-term results by looking past market noise to identify and isolate the factors that matter most, and by developing ideas that stand up to rigorous testing. By putting theory into practice, we have become a leader in alternative strategies and an innovator in traditional portfolio management since 1998.

At AQR, our employees share a common spirit of academic excellence, intellectual honesty and an unwavering commitment to seeking the truth. We’re determined to know what makes financial markets tick – and we’ll ask every question and challenge every assumption.  We recognize and respect the power of collaboration and believe transparency and openness to new ideas leads to innovation.

The Team

The Managed Futures & Commodities team is responsible for the portfolio management and research of AQR’s directional strategies across macro asset classes (equity index, fixed income, currencies, and commodities) as well as AQR’s relative-value commodities strategies. The team’s mandate includes dedicated directional products such as managed futures but also components of AQR’s multi-strategy hedge funds.

Your Role

AQR is looking for an exceptionally talented professional to join our team as a Research Analyst. You will have the opportunity to participate in a variety of integral business functions including signal research, data analysis, portfolio optimization, and risk management. This role will provide the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in quantitative research as well as the opportunity to become familiar with quantitative asset management and the investment philosophy which drives AQR. You will work in collaboration with researchers and portfolio managers in developing and maintaining trading strategies for the firm.

- Engage in the development of AQR’s proprietary quantitative investment strategies

- Perform statistical and economic research on financial data related to systematic strategies

- Work closely with portfolio managers to assist in the implementation of investment strategies

- Add features to proprietary research system to implement new research ideas

- Participate in the design and development of research infrastructure for the purpose of conducting economic and statistical research

What You’ll Bring

- B.S. in a quantitative field (e.g. Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Math, Engineering etc.)

- 2-3 years’ work experience at a quantitative finance firm, with exposure to commodities, futures / managed futures (CTA), rates / fixed income, equities, or FX

- Programming skills with demonstrated experience; Python preferred but not required

- Strong problem solving and quantitative skills

- High degree of intellectual curiosity

- Ability to communicate effectively in both verbal and written form

- Strong GPA and SAT scores

Who You Are

- Mature and thoughtful, with the ability to operate within a collaborative, team-oriented culture

- Committed to intellectual integrity, with a high degree of ethics

- Hard- working and eager to learn in a highly intellectual, innovative environment

- Well- organized, detail- oriented, with strong communication skills; able to multi-task and keep track of various deadlines

The salary range for this role is expected to be $225,000 to $245,000.  This is the range that we in good faith believe is accurate for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, depending upon factors such as skills, experience, location, or other business and organizational needs.  This wage range may also be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

AQR is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  EEO/VET/DISABILITY

jobs.title: ESG Business Development Analyst – EMEA
jobs.description:
The Team

AQR is looking to hire an Analyst to join our EMEA Business Development team, with a particular focus on ESG and sustainability.

This is a hybrid role. The successful candidate will have primary responsibility for supporting AQR’s ESG-related Business Development activities while also working as an integrated member of the established EMEA Business Development Analyst team.

The EMEA Business Development group works with clients across Europe, Latin America and the Middle East to understand their investment objectives and provide appropriate investment solutions. Our clients include some of the world’s largest institutional investors as well as participants in the private-wealth market.

The role provides an opportunity to develop specialist expertise in ESG and sustainability while gaining broad exposure to AQR’s investment strategies, institutional clients and wider Business Development activities.

Your Role

The Analyst will act as an important link between AQR’s ESG activities, the EMEA Business Development team and our clients. ESG and sustainability will form the core of the role, supplemented by broader Business Development responsibilities and support for the EMEA team. This role is particularly well suited to a candidate who wants to build specialist expertise in ESG and sustainability within an investment-management and client-facing environment, without being confined to a narrowly defined ESG position. The successful candidate will become part of the broader EMEA Business Development Analyst team, gaining exposure to institutional investors, AQR’s investment strategies and senior professionals across the firm while developing a distinct area of expertise in ESG and sustainability.

Responsibilities will include:

- ESG & Sustainability

- Partner with Business Development colleagues on ESG-related client requests, including Requests for Proposal/Information (RFP/RFI) and Due Diligence Questionnaires (DDQs).

- Support AQR’s ESG stewardship, proxy voting and sustainability reporting activities, including UNPRI, SFDR and the ESG Annual Report.

- Act as a central Business Development point of contact for sustainability-related projects and investor inquiries, coordinating with relevant colleagues across the firm.

- Develop a strong understanding of AQR’s approach to ESG and sustainability and communicate that approach clearly and consistently to clients and prospective investors.

- Remain current on relevant ESG and sustainability trends and developments and help disseminate key findings internally.

- Support the development and maintenance of high-quality ESG-related client and marketing materials.

- Work collaboratively with colleagues across Business Development and other functions to ensure ESG-related client inquiries and projects are handled accurately, consistently and in a timely manner.

- EMEA Business Development

- Alongside the ESG mandate, the Analyst will work as part of the broader EMEA Business Development Analyst team and support its ongoing client and business development activities. Responsibilities will include:

- Support senior members of the EMEA Business Development team in building and deepening relationships with investors.

- Develop strong knowledge of AQR’s investment strategies, products and asset classes.

- Support the preparation and completion of RFPs, RFIs and DDQs to a high standard, coordinating with colleagues across the business.

- Liaise with Business Development colleagues to update marketing materials and help leverage AQR’s intellectual capital, including white papers, webinars and investment analysis.

- Work with portfolio managers and other investment professionals to create and maintain high-quality client presentation materials.

- Help coordinate responses to investor inquiries, drawing on the appropriate resources and expertise from across the firm.

- Support the preparation and coordination of client meetings and conference calls.

- Provide broader analytical and project support to the EMEA Business Development team as required.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline; sustainability-related qualifications are a plus.

- At least 2 years of relevant post-undergraduate professional experience. Experience within investment management, financial services, professional services or consulting would be advantageous.

- A demonstrable interest in ESG, sustainability and investment management.

- High degree of intellectual curiosity and an appetite to develop a detailed understanding of AQR’s investment strategies and approach.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- High proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel; knowledge of Python is a plus.

- Ability to produce consistently high-quality work while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

Who You Are

- Well-organized and highly detail-oriented.

- Intellectually curious, with an interest in understanding both ESG issues and the wider investment management industry.

- A self-starter who is comfortable working independently while thriving in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

- Committed to excellent client service and consistently high standards of output.

- Comfortable working with colleagues across different teams, functions and levels of seniority.

- Willing to challenge existing approaches constructively and bring curiosity and an innovative mindset to new responsibilities.

- Goal-oriented, accountable and motivated by continued learning and professional development.

- A person of strong integrity whose approach is consistent with AQR’s values and core principles.

AQR is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Vice President Business Development - Hong Kong
jobs.description:
The Team

AQR is seeking an experienced client-facing professional to join our Business Development Team in Hong Kong with the goal of expanding AQR’s relationships with regional and global Private Banks throughout Asia. AQR clients include Wealth & Private Bank partners as well as a cross-section of the world’s largest institutional investors, including public and corporate pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and foundations and endowments.

The successful candidate will develop a deep understanding of our products and communicate investment strategy and performance to distribution partners throughout Asia.  Close collaboration with Hong Kong colleagues and with AQR’s global research, portfolio management, business development and client service teams will be necessary to ensure a high level of service to investors.

Your Role

- Identify, cultivate, and develop new business opportunities across wealth management firms, private banks, and other intermediary distribution channels in Asia.

- Serve as a key point of contact for existing distribution partners and provide after-sales service to help drive strong client retention and relationship expansion.

- Engage in direct verbal, written and interpersonal communication with clients and colleagues to confidently articulate and communicate ideas, portfolio updates, and other relevant information.

- Develop in-depth knowledge of AQR’s investment strategies; speak confidently and credibly across a wide range of strategies and products.

- Maintain highly consultative and solutions-based discussions with existing and prospective clients; serve as a strategic advisor in communicating our product offerings while addressing broader asset allocation needs.

- Significant involvement in business strategy including new product development and new business lines.

- Monitor and understand industry trends; proactively leverage internal resources to stay top of mind and relevant with investors.

What You’ll Bring

The successful candidate will be an experienced client-facing professional or product specialist with a minimum of seven to ten years’ experience working for a private bank, wealth manager, or investment management firm.

- Bachelor’s degree: concentrations in Economics, Finance, Marketing, or Business preferred; advanced degree is a plus.

- Established network within the wealth management and private banking ecosystem.

- 5–10 years of proven success raising assets and achieving fundraising targets across wealth management and intermediary channels in Asia, with demonstrated excellence in client retention, relationship development, and high-quality post-sale client servicing.

- Experience with a diverse suite of products, including equities and liquid alternatives (hedge funds). Familiar with a range of investment approaches, including quantitative/systematic approaches.

- Demonstrated ability to build and manage client relationships and originate new business opportunities.

- Strong commercial acumen with a disciplined, process-oriented approach to pipeline management.

- Technical grounding in investment strategies and portfolio construction; ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.

- Team-oriented professional with a collaborative mindset and demonstrated ability to build strong internal and external relationships.

- Knowledge of finance and the investment management industry.

- Business fluent in Mandarin and English (written and spoken) is required.

- Experience at global private bank(s) preferred.

- Based in Hong Kong.

Who You Are

- Highly collaborative; thrives in a high functioning team-oriented environment

- A great listener with the capacity to understand and empathize with the audience

- Intellectually curious with innovative, intuitive and creative ideas

- Adaptable – intellectually sharp, decisive and agile; able to thrive in a dynamic environment with sound judgment

- Entrepreneurial, resourceful and driven

- Presents and communicates with maturity, credibility and clarity. Superior written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.

- Articulate, with the ability to develop and leverage relationships across a wide range of professionals

jobs.title: 2027 PhD Summer Associate, Machine Learning Research
jobs.description:
About AQR Capital Management

Founded in 1998, AQR is a global systematic investment management firm. As quantitative investors, research is the foundation of everything we do. We manage a range of alternative and long-only strategies designed to meet the needs of institutional and wealth investors around the world.

AQR’s culture reflects the firm’s academic roots and entrepreneurial spirit. Our collaborative environment fuels innovation and encourages employees to ask thoughtful questions, think creatively and bring new ideas forward. Continuous learning is an important part of the employee experience, helping our people build skills and grow throughout their careers. Employees at every level have opportunities to contribute, regardless of title or tenure.

The firm has 800 employees with headquarters in Greenwich, Connecticut and offices in London, Frankfurt, Dubai, Hong Kong, Sydney and Bengaluru.

The Internship Program

Our 10-week summer program puts real work of the firm in your hands. You will work alongside brilliant people, gain insights and know-how from our Quanta Academy Summer Term   curriculum, and experience what it’s like to work at the pinnacle of global, systematic investing.

Learning is the cornerstone of our culture and plays an active role in the internship experience — through daily collaboration and interaction with employees at all levels, in workshops and classes, and most significantly by working on projects that matter to the many clients we serve. Our unique AQR Quanta Academy: Summer Term learning series, a structured program, consists of over 40 hours of educational, skill-building and networking events.

Your Role

AQR Capital Management is seeking a Research Associate to join our team of professionals and focus on our machine learning proprietary strategies related to global stock selection, asset allocation, risk management and trading. Candidates should be motivated and enthusiastic about implementing new ideas and are expected to be hands-on and self-sufficient in conducting all aspects of research projects. The role will involve collaboration with other researchers, portfolio managers, risk managers and traders to develop new and improve current investment strategies. As a summer intern your projects will include aspects of the following:

- Performing statistical and economic research using financial data to develop new, and improve current machine learning investment strategies in collaboration with existing research teams

- Conducting research on various aspects of the implementation of investment strategies such as trading cost models, risk models, optimization, and portfolio construction

- Adding features to proprietary research system to implement new research ideas

- Participating in the design and development of research infrastructure for the purpose of conducting economic and statistical research

What You’ll Bring

- December 2027 or Spring 2028 PhD candidate from a top program in finance, economics, or a quantitative discipline (Operations Research, Applied Math, Computer Science, Statistics, etc.)

- Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and how they are applied to finance preferred

- Research experience with AI and agentic frameworks preferred

- Experience with high performance computing and cloud computing

- Experience with AIML modeling and machine learning software libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

- Experience conducting empirical research, including the cleaning, structuring, and analyzing large data sets

- Strong background in econometrics or statistics

- Knowledge of optimization methods

- Coding experience in Python, R, C++, or MATLAB required

- Strong analytical and problem solving skills

- Strong presentation skills and ability to discuss and explain involved concepts in both verbal and written form

AQR is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  EEO/VET/DISABILITY

jobs.title: Global Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Associate / VP
jobs.description:
About AQR Capital Management

Founded in 1998, AQR is a global systematic investment management firm. As quantitative investors, research is the foundation of everything we do. We manage a range of alternative and long-only strategies designed to meet the needs of institutional and wealth investors around the world.

AQR’s culture reflects the firm’s academic roots and entrepreneurial spirit. Our collaborative environment fuels innovation and encourages employees to ask thoughtful questions, think creatively and bring new ideas forward. Continuous learning is an important part of the employee experience, helping our people build skills and grow throughout their careers. Employees at every level have opportunities to contribute, regardless of title or tenure.

The firm has 800 employees with headquarters in Greenwich, Connecticut and offices in London, Frankfurt, Dubai, Hong Kong, Sydney and Bengaluru.

The Team

The Compliance group is responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and testing AQR’s control environment. It is responsible for ensuring the firm is acting as a responsible fiduciary to our clients. It creates sets of policies and procedures that define how AQR operates its business. It analyzes and visualizes data to monitor the activities of the organization and give advice to other functions. It is also mandated with ensuring AQR complies with all relevant regulatory and industry rules and regulations.

We are currently seeking an exceptionally talented individual with five to seven years’ with experience with regulatory reporting, including derivatives transaction reporting, preferably with an investment manager, broker-dealer, or fund administrator, to join our Compliance Department.

Your Role

- Assist in the preparation and submission of all regulatory reports filed on behalf of the firm.

- Coordinate collecting and synthesizing data for various daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to U.S. and foreign regulators and departments, such as the SEC’s Form PF and Form ADV, CFTC and NFA’s Form CPO-PQR, and FCA’s AIFMD Annex.

- Develop and document internal processes and procedures related to the firm’s various current and future filing obligations.

- Keep abreast of global regulatory developments, particularly in the U.S., Asia, and Europe, and apprise other departments and groups of applicable requirements by researching regulatory and filing rules and writing and communicating guidelines and while becoming a part of a strategic solution for process and control modifications within the firm.

What You’ll Bring

- An undergraduate degree with a focus in Accounting, Finance or Computer Science

- In depth experience with Form PF, Form CPO-PQR, Form ADV, and Annex IV

- Demonstrated ability to improve processes, create efficiencies

- High proficiency in Excel and Bloomberg

- Knowledge of complex financial derivatives

- Experience with SQL or Python is a plus

Who You Are

- Intelligent, energetic and goal-oriented with the ability to juggle multiple tasks, meet deadlines with limited supervision and exercise sound judgment.

- A self-starter with the ability to follow through and complete tasks in a highly intellectual, collaborative environment.

- Well-organized and detail-oriented.

- Able to focus on details and their interaction, while keeping in mind the bigger picture.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills; must be able to confidently collaborate with senior management and various departments within the firm.

The salary range for this role is expected to be $140,000 to $160,000.  This is the range that we in good faith believe is accurate for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, depending upon factors such as skills, experience, location, or other business and organizational needs.  This wage range may also be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

AQR is an Equal Opportunity Employer. EEO/VET/DISABILITY
